top_creatures.label: Reactive skirmisher (wolf-style jump-back)
top_creatures.why: Short hop back that reads as a predator sizing up the player; a clear backward shape at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: hop only at close range and while facing the target (npc.cpp:1604)
top_creatures.change: our own cone (donor uses 90 degrees, fightalgo.cpp:318), our cadence, our creature; no wolf model or name

top_creatures.label: Counter-strafe after being hit
top_creatures.why: A hit clears the planned moves and queues one counter-move, so the enemy looks reactive with no new animation
top_creatures.keep: hit flag plus one counter-move from its own list
top_creatures.change: our move names and the counter choice

classes: No class or race records in box. Guild index selects per-guild fight ranges (fightalgo.cpp:239-258); guild table is script data, not read.
Weapon state selects the fight branch: fist, one-hand, two-hand, bow, crossbow, mage, unarmed (fightalgo.cpp:348-360, branch at :53-81). Progression: none in box.
weapon_families: Damage flags named in code (8): barrier, blunt, edge, fire, fly, magic, point, fall (touchdamage.cpp:37-44); each weapon carries a damage-type mask (damagecalculator.cpp:189-193)
Talent split one-hand and two-hand (damagecalculator.cpp:143-146); weapon length added to attack range (fightalgo.cpp:345, 349-352)
Item records are script data, not in box; visual tiers not in box
gear_tiers: Protection per damage flag, subtracted and floored at zero; negative value means immune (damagecalculator.cpp:117-118)
No armour sets, material tiers or colour tiers in box; tier display not read (common/ui not read)
zones: Biomes and dungeon archetypes: none in box (zone data in world files)
14 trigger types under common/world/triggers (zonetrigger, touchdamage, movetrigger, earthquake and others); only touchdamage.cpp read in full
Hazards: touch damage by flag with repeat delay (touchdamage.cpp:29-54); fall damage from speed and per-guild height table (damagecalculator.cpp:38-58)

looks.label: Water swell with a floor
looks.technique: Directional Gerstner sum, phase from tick count, amplitude max(10, half of max amplitude)

looks.label: Two-by-three music tag grid
looks.technique: One daytime bit and three mode bits (standard, fight, threat) combine into a tag set; theme chosen by tag set

looks.label: Sky look-up table with multiple scattering
looks.technique: Precomputed look-up plus multiple-scattering term (audit cites :15 and :58; not re-read here)

looks.label: Repeat-timed hazard tick
looks.technique: Zone hazard applies damage per flag on a repeat timer, not every frame

originals.name: Reactive skirmisher
originals.idea: An enemy that backs off with a short hop only when close and facing the player, so the move reads as calculated
originals.keep: close-range plus facing gate for the hop
originals.change: our cone, cadence and creature design

originals.name: Glancing blow tier
originals.idea: A failed hit roll becomes a graze, not a miss
originals.change: float maths with a floor of 1, our ratio, our roll name

originals.name: Counter-move after a hit
originals.idea: A hit clears the planned moves and queues one counter-move

originals.name: Three-tier range set, squared compare
originals.idea: Attack, close-up (0.75 of base) and walk ranges from base plus weapon reach, compared as squared distance

originals.name: Protection with immune sign
originals.idea: Armour is one number per damage flag; a negative number means immune
originals.keep: sign means immune; floor at zero

originals.name: Repeat-timed zone hazard
